source: DataV.GeoAtlas (阿里云 DataV 地理小工具)

conversion.method: single-step inverse of the GCJ-02 offset, per vertex
conversion.residual_m: 0.6 median, up to ~5 at the edges of the covered area
conversion.note: Every vertex carries this systematic residual on top of the source's own accuracy; sub-metre boundary decisions are noise.
